name: Video — attach subtitles
description: Adds the subtitle file as a soft track (mov_text) instead of burning it in: players can switch it off, and the video stream is copied untouched.

parameters.label: Video file (name in input/ or path in project)

notes: Pairs directly with the Whisper SRT export. Soft subtitles keep the picture bit-identical, which burning them in does not.
